acceptance.criterion_verbatim: READS8-AC1: the result is complete, its verdict follows from its arms by the rule of step 4, the tie is stated (a digest and a source or UNTIED), the write list is empty, and it holds no id, address or link.
acceptance.output_evidence: verdict ANOMALY: control ok=None url_present=True; b=NOT_AUTHORIZED; a=FIRM_BINDING; b_absent_id=NOT_AUTHORIZED / FAIL: verdict ANOMALY does not follow from the arms (the rule gives UNEXERCISED_LIVE) / READS8-FAIL
acceptance.denominator: 4 arms invoked once each of 4 ordered; control log lines read for the control invoke (CLEAN); 0 open ledger entries naming irpt-status of 36 across 2 worktrees
acceptance.status_reason: The measured result has verdict ANOMALY by the order's rule (the control was served a download route but its envelope has no ok:true: the member was absent or null, not separated). reads8_check.py expects UNEXERCISED_LIVE for a control whose ok is not true, which would say the record was unreachable; it was reachable. The seat did not change the verdict to pass the check. One run only; a second run needs the issuer's word. The issuer owns the verdict rule and the check.

read_can_see_a_row.description: The control arm on the same record was served a download route (link, expiry, sha256 and byte_length present), so the record is reachable and the b refusal is not the absent-record answer; b_absent_id gave the same code as b, which is why b alone proves nothing.

read_can_see_a_row.observed: control served (url present); b NOT_AUTHORIZED; b_absent_id NOT_AUTHORIZED
